name: AdGuard DNS public filtering resolvers (JSON DoH)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted). The terms class stays 'unknown' until legal records them (P020 cond 2).

reliability.justification: Ad/tracker and adult-content filter lists: a block is a content category, never a maliciousness signal (P020 cond 4, 6). The JSON answers carry no Authority section, so an AdGuard NXDOMAIN cannot be told apart from a filter NXDOMAIN: sink addresses only.

default.title: AdGuard DNS default filter (dns.adguard-dns.com /resolve, ads and trackers): content-filter verdicts

terms.quote: Opt-in module protective_dns_extra (default_enabled=False) holds AdGuard (dns.adguard-dns.com, family.adguard-dns.com), OpenDNS (doh.opendns.com) and CleanBrowsing. AdGuard and OpenDNS stay terms 'unknown' until legal records their terms

default.notes: Quote: binding council text (P020 cond 2). Category ads (cond 4). Block form 0.0.0.0 / :: (default blocking mode) or 94.140.14.35 (block page, research, unverified live).

family.title: AdGuard DNS family filter (family.adguard-dns.com /resolve, ads + adult content + safe search): content-filter verdicts

terms.quote: Opt-in module protective_dns_extra (default_enabled=False) holds AdGuard (dns.adguard-dns.com, family.adguard-dns.com), OpenDNS (doh.opendns.com) and CleanBrowsing. AdGuard and OpenDNS stay terms 'unknown' until legal records their terms

family.notes: Quote: binding council text (P020 cond 2). Category family/adult (cond 4); safe-search CNAME rewrites are not blocks.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-3 (P020, module protective_dns_extra). JSON DoH /resolve answers use content-type application/x-javascript and names with a trailing dot (live 2026-11-26).
